results.rationale: Consistency: the gray ground and dark grip surface remain recognizable, but the board is reoriented much more horizontally, its intact end changes shape, and the ground texture and framing change. Instruction: a lower deck and front wheels have been added; a completed skateboard should have a continuous repaired deck. The jagged broken colorful section remains on top of a separate-looking extension, so completion is only partial. Quality: texture and lighting are plausible, but the doubled deck and splintered upper section form a visibly incoherent board structure.

Consistency: the pale background, gray fluted columns and receding row remain, but column spacing and framing change noticeably, and the shafts, capital profiles and bases are reshaped. Instruction: the row is redrawn but still contains eight columns; the expected result is exactly five columns, so the requested count change is absent. Quality: structural coherence, lighting, clean silhouettes and surface shading are satisfactory; the columns form a coherent rendering without noticeable artifacts.
